name: Tabs
import: import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from "@/components/ui/tabs"
description: Accessible tabbed navigation for switching between related content panels.

Tabs.description: Root state holder built on Base UI Tabs.

defaultValue.description: Initial uncontrolled active tab value. Defaults to the first enabled tab.

onValueChange.description: Called when the active tab changes.

variant.description: Segmented default tabs or compact line tabs.

activateOnFocus.description: When true, arrow-key focus activates the tab immediately.

loopFocus.description: Whether keyboard focus wraps at the ends.

TabsTrigger.description: Button that activates a matching TabsContent panel.

value.description: Value matched by a TabsContent panel.

children.description: Short label and optional leading icon.

TabsContent.description: Panel shown when the matching trigger is active.

forbidden: Do not use Tabs for unrelated destinations; use navigation.
Do not hide required actions behind tabs.
Do not create tab labels that wrap across multiple lines.
Do not put long horizontal tab lists on mobile without a deliberate scroll container.
Do not use Tabs when a segmented toggle or filter is the real control.

responsive.note: Triggers keep 44px touch targets. Keep all primary tabs visible when possible; use short labels on mobile.

example:
<Tabs defaultValue="activity">
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTrigger value="activity">Activity</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="files">Files</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="activity">Activity panel</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="files">Files panel</TabsContent>
</Tabs>
